sources.title: What is the difference between a loan interest rate and the APR?
sources.uncertainty: Which charges are finance charges is transaction-specific.
sources.limitations: Tool uses user-entered fees and does not classify legal finance charges.

sources.title: Appendix J to Part 1026 — Annual Percentage Rate Computations for Closed-End Credit Transactions
sources.uncertainty: Irregular periods, dates and fee classification require full Regulation Z treatment.
sources.limitations: Implementation only covers equal monthly periods and therefore labels output a cash-flow APR estimate.

assumptions: Single advance, equal monthly periods, equal payments, fees exactly as entered; no legal fee classification.
uncertainty: Not a legal APR disclosure engine; irregular dates, multiple advances and regulatory fee classification are unsupported.
